goal: Warn users when post-encryption database cleanup fails instead of silently leaving plaintext keys on disk
Advise users to transfer funds if leftover storage pages could still contain recoverable key material
agreement: Suggests dropping this code when encryptwallet is removed rather than adding warnings (achow101)
Suggests toggling secure_delete with RAII rather than relying on vacuuming afterwards (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because database rewrite failures after encryption are rare edge cases
Alerts users to lingering plaintext key material they would otherwise assume is encrypted
